prompt: What is the name of the father of the first cousin of the mother of the man whose name inspired the naming of the lunar mountain "Mons Hansteen"?
answer: The man was **Christopher Hansteen**. His mother’s first cousin was **Niels Treschow (1751–1833)**, whose father was also named **Niels Treschow**—the elder Niels Treschow, a merchant and shipowner.
